title: Graphic | Developerblog – Johannes Jendersie
abstract: Describes a hybrid voxel renderer using geometry shader instancing and ray marching of volume textures. Details an integer-based DDA traversal algorithm for efficient voxel sampling and neighbor-sensitive masking.
